verdict.rationale: Parsec documents a Teams API, linked at /docs/teams-api, for automating deployment and pulling audit logs, so it offers its own API for automation and reporting. However, the API is tied to the Teams plan and appears scoped to admin, deployment and reporting tasks rather than driving the product broadly, and probes found no OpenAPI spec, llms.txt or markdown docs. missing for 10: evidence of API coverage beyond deployment/audit (e.g. session/connection control), machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI), availability outside the Teams tier, independent or hands-on corroboration of the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
